capabilities: Track recently opened or edited files in an internal list
Add a Recent files view to any Base
Sort entries strictly by recency, ignoring the Base sort
Cap entries with a per-view Max items slider
Show relative last-opened timestamps that refresh each minute
disambiguation: Not a standalone recent-files sidebar; it adds a view type that is selected inside .base files.
extras: Recency is stored in the plugin's own data file, not in note frontmatter, and the plugin writes nothing to notes. All Bases filter one shared tracked list, so a Base scoped to a folder can show fewer entries than its Max items slider allows.
intentEvidence: adds a custom Bases view listing your recently opened files, in list format
problem: Bases can filter and sort notes by their properties but not by when you last opened them, so a recency-ordered view is not possible on its own.

relations.evidence: its settings shape (path and tag exclusion, open-vs-edit tracking) informed this plugin's settings

summary: Adds a Bases view type that lists recently opened files, filtered by the Base and ordered by recency.
